user.title: Water heater
user.description: Pick the heater's switch, the water temperature sensor and the price sensor.

data_description.volume_l: Needed to work out how long heating takes.
data_description.power_w: The heater's power when the element is on.
data_description.price_entity: The sensor that provides the electricity price, e.g. Nord Pool. It must show prices per hour or quarter (attributes raw_today/raw_tomorrow, prices or today/tomorrow). If it already includes tax, grid fee and VAT, leave the next step empty.
data_description.heater_power_entity: Measures the heater's real power (W). Used to learn the energy need exactly. Without it, full power is assumed while the switch is on.
data_description.energy_day_entity: The heater's energy so far today (kWh). Shown in the card's usage popup. Without it, what the integration has measured itself is used.
data_description.energy_week_entity: The heater's energy so far this week (kWh).
data_description.energy_month_entity: The heater's energy so far this month (kWh).

solar.title: Solar (optional)
solar.description: Needed for Solar and Hybrid modes. Skip it if you only want Cheapest.

data_description.solar_start_w: Defaults to 80 % of the heater's power.

fiscal.title: Electricity price
fiscal.description: Only fill this in if the price sensor shows the bare spot price. If it already includes tax, grid fee and VAT, leave the fields empty. The unit follows the sensor (e.g. cent/kWh).

error.price_sensor_unsupported: The sensor has no price list. Pick a price sensor with the attributes raw_today/raw_tomorrow, prices or today/tomorrow.

wait_saving.name: Wait for a cheaper hour only if it saves

early_keep_pct.name: Early start: surplus to keep going

sell_other_sun.name: Solar mode: sell surplus outside the chosen sun hours

sun_surplus_only.name: Solar mode: heat in sun hours only when the surplus is enough

sun_priced.name: Solar mode: price the sun as unsold electricity
